boundaries.source: AQA's published subject grade boundaries (June series). The A-level total is 85 + 85 + 80 = 250 raw marks, with no weighting. AQA sets a separate A-level boundary for each Paper 3 option; the figures here are the indicative subject boundaries as summarised by tutor2u from AQA's data, so your option's boundary may differ by a few marks. The AS total is 140 (two 70-mark papers), straight from AQA. The June 2026 papers themselves are not yet public.
